headline: Egypt’s GAFI and Oracle Partner to Train 150,000 Egyptians in Cloud Computing
summary: Egypt’s General Authority for Investment and Free Zones and Oracle agreed to provide advanced cloud computing training for Egyptian entrepreneurs and government employees.
why: Workforce development initiatives focused on cloud computing and digital technology support economic modernization and foreign technology investment in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Oracle Corp.
impacts.why: Strategic partnership expands Oracle's cloud computing footprint and brand presence in Egypt.
